KeyValue.description: Key-value pair used for environment variables or generic metadata.

key.description: Name of the variable or key.

SubprocessMode.description: Execution strategy for a subprocess task: command runs an executable with arguments; script runs a base64 body through an interpreter with arguments.

oneOf.description: Script execution via an explicit interpreter.

args.description: Additional arguments passed after the script body.

TaskEnv.description: Environment variables passed to a task at submission time. Duplicate keys are allowed; lookup uses the last value.

description: Specification for subprocess execution on the host, in command or script mode. env, cwd and failOnNonZero apply to both modes.

failOnNonZero.description:
Whether to treat non-zero exit codes as task failure.

When enabled (default), any non-zero exit code will be reported as a failure.

title: SubprocessSpec
